requirements.requirement_statement: The U1 switching path shall remain PWM-inactive after power-up and reset until a deliberate arming transition is completed.
requirements.rationale: B1 separates driver wake from switching permission and does not credit power-up state as armed.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: No uncontrolled PWM assertion occurs before the defined arm transition in all supported startup/reset sequences.

requirements.requirement_statement: A latched hardware fault shall not silently restore switching permission unless the frozen vehicle safety policy explicitly defines and verifies automatic re-arm behavior.
requirements.rationale: B1 explicitly forbids automatic re-arm and uses a separate fault latch/arm clock.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Post-fault switching state matches the frozen re-arm policy for every defined fault class.

requirements.requirement_statement: The complete asynchronous hardware fault path shall be measured from fault stimulus to PWM inactive state and shall meet the final semiconductor safe-action budget.
requirements.rationale: Comparator, latch, logic and gate-driver delays accumulate and cannot be replaced by individual datasheet headline delays.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Measured worst-case fault-to-PWM-inactive latency including relevant filtering is within the frozen safe-action limit with stated margin.

requirements.requirement_statement: If an external emergency-stop or inhibit interface is required, its normal, asserted, open-circuit, short-circuit and disconnected states shall be explicitly defined and fail-safe behavior shall be verified to the vehicle safety requirement.
requirements.rationale: The B1 simple active-low contact does not detect cable break and is not a certified safety loop.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All defined wiring faults produce the frozen safe behavior without relying on an undocumented state.

requirements.requirement_statement: The CAN physical layer shall satisfy the frozen protocol, bit rate, cable length, node count, termination, temperature, transient-protection and grounding/isolation requirements.
requirements.rationale: B1 uses a Classic-CAN transceiver with DNP termination and an unresolved TVS placeholder while the vehicle protocol and environment remain open.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Selected controller/transceiver/protection/termination/harness meet the frozen interface contract over the required environmental range.

requirements.requirement_statement: The motor-temperature input shall have a frozen sensor electrical model, temperature range, conversion method and open/short diagnostic behavior before schematic freeze.
requirements.rationale: B1 assumes a resistive motor sensor but the actual motor thermistor type is not proven.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Temperature conversion and sensor-fault thresholds are traceable to the selected motor sensor and verified across the required range.

requirements.requirement_statement: FET and PCB temperature sensing shall use a characterized R-T relation and shall be placed so the measured temperature has a documented relation to the protected thermal node.
requirements.rationale: B1 identifies an exact NTC family but final U1 thermal geometry and allowable temperatures are not frozen.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Sensor conversion error and thermal-location offset are bounded sufficiently to enforce the frozen thermal protection thresholds.

requirements.requirement_statement: If Hall commutation/position inputs are supported, the Hall supply, output electrical type, voltage levels, current, edge timing and invalid-state behavior shall be defined by an explicit motor interface contract.
requirements.rationale: B1 assumes open-collector-compatible outputs; a 5 V push-pull Hall sensor would require a different interface proof.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All Hall voltage/current/timing limits and invalid-state responses are compatible with the selected motor and MCU interface.

requirements.requirement_statement: Every production external or board-to-board connector shall have an exact orderable connector/mate, pin-map authority, keying/orientation definition, electrical derating and mechanical/environmental qualification evidence.
requirements.rationale: B1 includes unkeyed PoC headers and a logical 2x20 same-net interface that do not prove UAV harness retention or mating correctness.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Zero unresolved mating/orientation/pin/current/voltage/environmental issues remain before production package release.

requirements.requirement_statement: Every exported auxiliary power rail shall have bounded continuous, peak/inrush, short-circuit, reverse-current and powered-off backfeed behavior before converter sizing is frozen.
requirements.rationale: B1 fan and exported +5 V loads are not closed product contracts.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All external loads and fault states fit the selected auxiliary converter/protection architecture with documented margin.

anti_hallucination_rule: Requirement statements are defined, but numeric limits and final selections remain OPEN until supported by frozen parent requirements, primary evidence or measurements.
